notes: The text says one outer pin to 5V, the centre pin to A0, the other outer pin to ground. The image shows the potentiometer in columns 10, 11 and 12, with the black wire on column 10 (GND) and the red wire on column 12 (5V).

In the image the yellow wire ends above the pot at column 11, drawn on the opposite half of the breadboard. I treated it as joined to the centre (wiper) strip, 11t.d, so that it connects electrically to the wiper. Breadboard rows are mapped so the half with the pot is the catalogue 't' bank (rows a-e).
The black wire goes to the lower of the two GND header sockets, which I named GND.2. Any Uno GND is equivalent.
The pot's GND and VCC legs are interchangeable (symmetric), so swapping the outer legs has no effect on the circuit.
The sketch only reads the analog value and prints the average over serial. No external LED circuit is listed. The USB cable to the computer is not drawn in the circuit image, so I left it out.
